verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਣੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: paanee dharatee vich dharat vich paaneeaai|

en.bdb: The water is in the earth and the earth in the water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨੀਚਹੁ ਨੀਚ ਨ ਹਿਚ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਾਣੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: neechahu neech na hich niramal jaaneeaai|

en.bdb: Water has no hesitation in going low and lower; it is rather considered more pure.
To flow down, water bears the concussion of the gravitational force but still likes to go lower.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਲੀ ਘੁਲ ਮਿਚ ਸਭ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੀਐ।
verses.translit_en: man melee ghul mich sabh ra(n)g maaneeaai|

en.bdb: It absorbs in everybody and enjoys with one and all.
Meeting once it does not go apart and hence it is acceptable in the court of the Lord.
The devoted persons (bhagats) are identified through their service (to the mankind)
